reels.name: 01_Can_You_Stop_The_Train_In_GTA6
reels.title: CAN YOU STOP THE GTA 6 TRAIN?!
reels.hook: CAN YOU FINALLY STOP THE TRAIN?!
reels.reason: Live collision test parking a heavy pickup across tracks to verify if the GTA 6 passenger train can be derailed or stopped.
reels.post_caption:
CAN YOU FINALLY STOP THE GTA 6 TRAIN?! In GTA 5 the train was literally indestructible, but in GTA 6 next-gen physics allow real collisions and emergency stops! Watch the high-speed impact!
